heading: Thursday, October 15, 2026
topLine: 2 model releases: Meta Muse Spark Open and Mistral AI Timestral.

items.headline: Meta releases Muse Spark Open open-weight model
items.summary: Muse Spark Open is an 816B-parameter (42B active) natively multimodal model with a 1M-token context, focused on coding and agentic work, which Meta calls the most capable US open-weight model to date. Weights are on Hugging Face and major clouds under the Muse Model License, which has limited commercial terms.

items.headline: Mistral releases Timestral time-series forecasting models
items.summary: Timestral is Mistral's first family of time-series foundation models, in four sizes from 5M to 209M parameters, for probabilistic multivariate forecasting, released under a modified MIT license. Mistral reports the 209M model ranks first on GIFT-Eval, TIME and fev-bench.
